current_metrics.methodology_label:
Same-country breakeven curve spread / inflation-compensation
term structure between two breakeven tenors of the same
nominal/linker pair (e.g. UST/USD_TIPS 2s10s breakeven,
UK_GILT/GBP_LINKER 5s30s breakeven).  Computed per-trade-date
via the SPREAD formula:

  spread_bps = long_breakeven_bps - short_breakeven_bps

where ``short_breakeven_bps`` and ``long_breakeven_bps`` are
the spot bond-implied breakevens at ``short_tenor`` and
``long_tenor`` respectively (each computed by
``calculate_breakeven_inflation_simple`` — same instrument-type
no-proxy guard, same same-country invariant).  The two
endpoint series are aligned per-trade-date via inner-join AFTER
each is computed independently; the spread is computed only
on dates where BOTH endpoints exist (no synthetic spread
points are produced).

Same-country construction only: the nominal sovereign and linker
legs must share country and currency (e.g. UST + USD_TIPS,
UK_GILT + GBP_LINKER, FR_OAT + EUR_FR_LINKER, CANADA_GOVT +
CAD_RRB).  Cross-country pairs (e.g. DE_BUND vs EUR_FR_LINKER,
or UK_GILT vs USD_TIPS) are refused at compute time with a
controlled error envelope; this invariant is enforced in code
(not via a YAML allow-list) per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md §5 and
is inherited from the spot breakeven primitive's
``_enforce_same_country_invariant`` helper which fires BEFORE
any market-data SELECT.

The output is the term structure of INFLATION COMPENSATION,
NOT the term structure of pure expected inflation, because
each endpoint breakeven carries an inflation risk premium and
a relative liquidity premium between the nominal sovereign and
the linker, and the curve spread inherits both at each
endpoint.  Use as a proxy for the term structure of inflation
expectations only with that caveat in mind.

time_series_spread.description: Same-country breakeven curve spread (UST-USD_TIPS) 5Y/10Y (long_breakeven_bps - short_breakeven_bps) over the displayed window.  Term structure of inflation compensation; not the term structure of pure expected inflation (carries inflation risk premium and liquidity premium at each endpoint).

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the UST-USD_TIPS breakeven curve spread (in bps) over 5Y/10Y vs its own trailing window.
